prompt: Lua types cannot be represented as literals
answer:
False. In Luau, types can be represented as literals—for example, `"dark"` and `true` are valid literal types. Literal types can also be combined into unions such as `"north" | "south" | "east" | "west"`.

Standard Lua itself is dynamically typed: variables do not have types; only values do.
